result.topic_en: Notes on the shortening of focal length caused by the thickness of a lens, noting that v must be the whole thickness rather than half, that the approximate formula gives 7.17 Zoll whereas the correct value in the example is 5.13 Zoll, and giving the approximate and exact formulas.
